name: Raccoon Range
tagline: Run a delivery-only food brand from a rented burner. No lease, no dining room, no regrets.
positioning: Raccoon Range hands solo cooks and side-hustlers the tools to launch, price, and ship a delivery-only menu from shared kitchen space overnight.

hero.h1: Your restaurant fits in a mini-fridge and a phone.
hero.sub: Rent an hour of kitchen, spin up a menu, and start taking delivery orders tonight. We handle the boring parts so you can go feral on flavor.

features.title: Kitchen-by-the-hour
features.description: Book verified commissary space near you like a hotel room. Show up, cook, leave. No lease, no walk-in freezer you don't understand.

features.title: Menu that prices itself
features.description: Type in your dish, we calculate food cost, delivery cut, and the exact price where you actually make money instead of feelings.

features.title: One inbox, every app
features.description: DoorDash, Uber Eats, and your own site pile into a single ticket rail so you stop staring at four blinking tablets like a raccoon at a dumpster.

features.title: Prep on autopilot
features.description: Tonight's orders roll into a prep list and a shopping run, portioned so you buy what sells and not another sad case of cilantro.

features.title: Brand kit in a box
features.description: Logo, packaging labels, and a delivery-ready storefront generated in minutes. Look like a chain, cook like a menace.

features.title: Money you can see
features.description: Real payout tracking after every fee, tip, and refund, so the number in your account stops being a spooky surprise.

testimonials.quote: I was selling birria out of a group chat. Raccoon Range gave me a bookable kitchen and a storefront in a weekend. I cleared rent by Thursday.
testimonials.name: Marisol Tran

testimonials.quote: The auto-prep list alone saved my sanity. I stopped double-buying, stopped tossing spoiled stock, and finally know my cost per plate to the cent.
testimonials.name: Devon Achebe

testimonials.quote: Four tablets became one ticket rail. My weekend order volume tripled and I didn't hire a soul. It's just me, a range, and a slightly smug feeling.
testimonials.name: Priya Kohler

pricing.blurb: For the curious cook testing one dish and one delivery app.
For the side-hustle that just became a real habit.
